commit.message:
App literal secrets: scope validation, UI drift, drain and preview leftovers (#1923)

Full batch of the remaining #1915 review-fix items, verified item by item
against main rather than assumed from the issue text:

Already done on main, not touched here:
- Orphaned literals Secret on last-literal-removal (1f416087).
- Bundle-name collision / reserved astrolift- prefix (c6af39c4, 2c34dbff).
- render_manifests envFrom parity (9e47c798).

Done together with the other two issues in this stack:
- Snapshot drift -- #1957's Deployment.secret_snapshot memoization.
- M3 rotation race on sync_app_domain -- #1952's reorder. Deploy, promote
  and rollback already reorder update_secrets before apply_manifests per
  #1915/#2048, confirmed in code rather than assumed.

New in this commit:

- Scope validation. _validate_scope only refused an explicit empty
  string. valid_scope_literal_error now refuses anything outside {all,
  production, preview, preview:<branch>} -- a typo, or an actual
  environment name typed into the scope field, used to silently hide
  the key from every environment with nothing to say why.

- UI secret list drift. _list_app_secrets computed its preview/branch
  map from PreviewEnvironment rows filtered to BUILDING/RUNNING, so a
  FAILED or torn-down preview fell through to the production scope set
  and showed production-scoped keys the deploy path already withheld
  (H2). preview_branches_for_app mirrors the deploy path's by-identity
  lookup, batched across every queried environment. AppSecretType also
  gains deploysAsShown (H1): false for a literal row whose staged value
  has no matching applied proposal, so the list can flag a value that
  won't deploy as shown, and a new revert-warning banner on the secrets
  page lists every such key ahead of the next deploy -- covers both a
  normal pending review and a value staged while approval was briefly
  off (the "approval off-then-on silently reverts" item).

- Source-cluster leftovers after a draining migration. drain_source_cluster
  rendered and deleted only the workload resource set; the literal
  Secret is synthesized separately by update_secrets and was never in
  that delete set, so it stayed on the source cluster holding the app's
  last plaintext values indefinitely. Now deleted alongside the
  workloads.

- Orphaned per-environment literal Secret after preview teardown.
  Previews deploy into the app's shared namespace, not the dedicated
  PreviewEnvironment.namespace that delete_preview_namespace deletes, so
  tearing down a preview's own namespace never touched its literal
  Secret sitting in the shared one. delete_preview_namespace now deletes
  it explicitly, reusing the same helper the last-literal-removal case
  already established.

Closes #1923.
